DIAGNOSIS READY: Transient Tachypnea of the Newborn (TTN) secondary to C-section delivery and maternal diabetes.

The clinical picture of respiratory distress improving with oxygen, a history of C-section, and maternal gestational diabetes is highly characteristic of TTN. I will await the Arterial Blood Gas and Chest X-Ray results to confirm the absence of meconium aspiration syndrome or pneumonia, but based on the response to oxygen and delivery method, TTN is the most likely diagnosis.
